question: Hello, Odacchi. I just recently noticed something. When reading Zoro and Kaku's fight in Volume 43, there is a pattern to his attack names. Nigiri → Nigiri sushi (hand-rolled sushi) Toro → Toro (tuna) Otoro → Otoro (fatty tuna) Hirameki → Hirame (flounder) Samon → Salmon He seems really fixated on sushi... Could Zoro-san have never had sushi before?!
answer: Who-ho-hoa, now, whoa... I think someone just accused you of some totally bogus crimes, Zoro-san! I think ANYONE would be upset at being the author of such a shocking display of puns in poor taste! Come on out and tell 'em it ain't so, Zoro!! Zoro: Gimme a break... Listen up, It... It ain't... so... O: WHAT ARE YOU ACTING SO SHOOK UP FOR?!!
name: Susshy
